analytical_limits: Legacy species niche vectors combine resource units and prey mass; they have no direct soft/hard energy axis.
Ecology4 retains temporal mouth-channel energy and lineage occupancy, but only lifetime lineage feeding channels; no continuous1000-tick per-lineage diet proof is claimed.
Predator-like and mouth cohorts describe inherited traits; prey-income acceptance separately requires sustained actual credited prey energy.
